# Rapid Admin

> 开箱即用的 Go + React 通用后台管理框架:RBAC 权限、数据范围、字段级加密脱敏、双级缓存、审计、通知、定时任务;51 个框架模块各配手册章节与 `go run` 即跑的示例。技术栈:Go 1.22+(Hertz + GORM + Casbin)· React 18 + Ant Design 5。

改本仓库代码的 AI agent 先读 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)(构建/测试命令与硬约束);拿框架开发自己业务的 agent 从下面的手册章节按需取。

## 手册 · 开始

- [首页](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/README.md)

- [快速开始](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/getting-started/README.md)

- [AI 接入(vibe coding)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/getting-started/ai-coding.md): agent 入口文件 / 生成物清单 / 守卫红了怎么读

- [配置体系](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/getting-started/configuration.md)

- [框架约定](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/getting-started/conventions.md)

## 手册 · 基础设施

- [logger(日志)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/logger.md): 多 Core 装配:控制台 + info/warn/error/audit/access 分文件

- [errcode(业务错误码)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/errcode.md): 分类、HTTP 映射、错误对象

- [response(统一响应体)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/response.md): 成功 / 失败 / 分页三种形状

- [validatorx(参数校验)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/validatorx.md): 统一参数校验:自定义规则 + 中文错误

- [pagination(分页)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/pagination.md): 分页参数解析与上限保护

- [jsonid(字符串 ID)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/jsonid.md): 以字符串形式上 wire 的主键(雪花 ID 不能用数字)

- [sonyflake(分布式 ID)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/sonyflake.md): 分布式 ID 生成 + worker id 分配

- [timeutil(时间工具)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/timeutil.md): 统一东八区的时间工具

- [buildinfo(构建信息)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/buildinfo.md): 编译期构建信息注入

- [syncx(并发原语)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/syncx.md): 单飞 / 优雅关停 / 计数信号量 / worker pool

- [randomx(安全随机)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/randomx.md): 安全随机 token 生成

- [retryx(重试)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/retryx.md): 指数退避重试

- [uainfo(UA 解析)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/uainfo.md): 解析 User-Agent,取出浏览器与操作系统

- [metricsx(指标)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/metricsx.md): Prometheus 指标 + `/metrics` handler

- [otelx(链路追踪)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/otelx.md): OpenTelemetry TracerProvider 初始化

- [apiverx(版本协商)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/apiverx.md): API 版本协商

- [grayx(灰度发布)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/infrastructure/grayx.md): 灰度发布 header 透传

## 手册 · 存储与缓存

- [cachex(两级缓存)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/storage/cachex.md): 两级缓存(L1 本地 LRU + L2 Redis)+ 三防

- [kvstore(计数与窗口)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/storage/kvstore.md): 计数 + 滑动窗口:Redis / 内存两种实现

- [searchidx(盲索引搜索)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/storage/searchidx.md): 加密字段的全文搜索(盲索引)

- [media(音视频处理)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/storage/media.md): 音视频处理:ffprobe 探测与 ffmpeg 转码

- [oss(对象存储)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/storage/oss.md): 对象存储统一抽象:本地磁盘 / 阿里云 OSS

## 手册 · 安全与合规

- [auth(登录鉴权)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/auth.md): JWT 签发 / 解析 / 吊销 + 强制下线

- [authz(资源鉴权)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/authz.md): 资源级鉴权原语:principal / grant

- [casbinx(策略引擎)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/casbinx.md): Casbin 初始化 + 策略行格式

- [crypto(字段加密)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/crypto.md): 字段级加密(AES-256-GCM)+ 盲索引

- [kms(密钥管理)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/kms.md): 密钥管理服务抽象层 + 轮转

- [desensitize(数据脱敏)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/desensitize.md): 请求体 / 查询串脱敏

- [signx(接口签名)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/signx.md): HMAC 接口签名 + 防重放

- [idempotentx(幂等键)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/idempotentx.md): 幂等键:防重复提交

- [ratelimitx(限流)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/ratelimitx.md): 进程内限流原语

- [loginlock(登录锁定)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/loginlock.md): 登录失败计数 + 账号锁定

- [anomalylogin(异常登录检测)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/anomalylogin.md): 异常登录检测

- [mfa(登录二次验证)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/mfa.md): 密码 + 短信码双因子:两步登录 / 自助开关 / 管理员恢复

- [scope(数据范围)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/scope.md): 数据范围(行级权限):规则 → 作用域 → WHERE

- [fieldpolicy(字段可见性)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/security/fieldpolicy.md): 字段级可见性(列级权限):三态模式 + 逐字段叠加 + 响应出口脱敏

## 手册 · 审计

- [piiaudit(PII 审计)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/audit/piiaudit.md): PII 访问审计:谁在什么时候看了手机号

- [cryptaudit(密钥审计)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/audit/cryptaudit.md): 密钥使用审计:哪个 key 被用过

- [smsaudit(短信审计)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/audit/smsaudit.md): 短信发送审计

## 手册 · 消息与通知

- [inbox(站内信)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/messaging/inbox.md): 站内信 + 通知中心:未读数 / 幂等 / 防 IDOR

- [notifyx(通知分发)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/messaging/notifyx.md): 多通道通知分发

- [push(推送通道)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/messaging/push.md): 服务端事件推送通道(SSE 的传输层地基)

- [pushx(推送下发)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/messaging/pushx.md): App 推送:抽象 Provider + 阿里云 EMNS

- [permnotify(权限广播)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/messaging/permnotify.md): 权限失效广播:改权限后让前端重拉

- [msn(短信通道)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/messaging/msn.md): 运行时可切换的短信 sender

- [smslimit(短信限流)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/messaging/smslimit.md): 短信发送限流:冷却 / 1 分钟 / 1 天三道闸

- [smstpl(短信模板)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/messaging/smstpl.md): 短信模板审核流 + 发送前守卫

- [emailx(邮件)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/messaging/emailx.md): 邮件下发:阿里云 DirectMail

## 手册 · 调度与可观测

- [cronx(定时任务)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/scheduling/cronx.md): 定时任务调度:代码注册 + DB 覆盖 + 两层去重

- [jobs(内置任务)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/scheduling/jobs.md): 平台内置定时任务:框架任务注册 + 执行记录清理

- [slowquery(慢 SQL 报警)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/scheduling/slowquery.md): 慢 SQL 报警:两种接入方式 + Prometheus 指标

## 手册 · 语音与媒体

- [voicex(语音克隆与合成)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/voice/voicex.md): DashScope 音色克隆 + TTS 文本合成(整段 / 流式两套形态,不用 WebSocket)

- [asrx(实时语音识别)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/voice/asrx.md): 百炼 Paraformer WS 实时识别 + 一句话识别(与 voicex 共用凭据)

## 手册 · 业务扩展

- [dynx(动态业务集合)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/business/dyn.md): 用户自己设计业务表,菜单/接口/权限/页面全自动

- [approvalx(通用审批)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/business/approval.md): 通用审批系统使用教程:一张单子的旅程(状态机)/ 或签会签详解(D5:逐级审批必须会签)/ 内置三条案例模板(请假/报销/采购,默认停用)+ 按角色配置的建模板教程 / 引擎内部逻辑(提交快照、会签数票、事务纪律、站内信与巡检)

- [框架手册](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leapar/rapid-admin/main/server/docs/api-docs/manual.md): 这一本手册怎么构建 / 内嵌 / 访问(`/docs`)
